description: Unit tests for sequenced socket data handling in net socket module, including reentrant operations, asynchronous and synchronous reads/writes, and pause/resume functionality.

classes.name: ReentrantHelper
classes.description: Helper class to facilitate reentrant asynchronous socket operations, verifying expectations and invoking subsequent read/write operations.

classes.name: SequencedSocketDataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing sequenced socket data operations, including synchronous/asynchronous reads/writes, reentrant operations, and pause/resume functionality.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::SetExpectedRead
methods.description: Sets expectation for a read operation with specific data and length.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::SetExpectedWrite
methods.description: Sets expectation for a write operation with specific length.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::SetInvokeRead
methods.description: Configures the helper to invoke a read with specified buffer, length, return value, and callback.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::SetInvokeWrite
methods.description: Configures the helper to invoke a write with specified data, length, return value, and callback.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::callback
methods.description: Returns the callback to be used for IO completion, bound to OnIOComplete.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::read_buf
methods.description: Returns the buffer expected to have been written during a read.

methods.name: ReentrantHelper::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles IO completion, verifies expectations, and invokes subsequent read/write.

methods.name: SequencedSocketDataTest::ReentrantReadCallback
methods.description: Verifies data read and triggers subsequent read operations.

methods.name: SequencedSocketDataTest::ReentrantAsyncReadCallback
methods.description: Verifies async read completion and triggers next read.

methods.name: SequencedSocketDataTest::ReentrantWriteCallback
methods.description: Verifies write completion and triggers next write.

methods.name: SequencedSocketDataTest::ReentrantAsyncWriteCallback
methods.description: Verifies async write completion and triggers next write.

methods.name: SequencedSocketDataTest::FailingCompletionCallback
methods.description: Callback that reports failure if invoked unexpectedly.
